review_evidence: The README states that the project teaches Lean as a software specification language and emphasizes dependent types in which type correctness expresses program correctness.
The 16 formal-source files specify quotient/remainder, sorting, knapsack, graph search, aviation scheduling and flight-planning data, plus temporal and geospatial support modules.

The source contains theorem/example statements and many refinement/dependent-type definitions intended as specifications, which are explicitly in scope for the corpus even when not organized as a traditional theorem library.
summary: Retain lean-spec: it is an explicit Lean development of executable software specifications using dependent types, with reusable temporal/geospatial support and worked specification case studies.
